europe_now.title: Black Sea Maritime Incident
europe_now.summary: Seven crew members remain missing after a drone attack caused a major fire on a tanker off the coast of Romania. NATO allies are scheduled to convene to address the escalating security risks to regional shipping.

sources.headline: Seven crew missing after drone attack leaves tanker ablaze off Romania's coast
NATO allies to meet over Black Sea drone attacks on shipping

europe_now.title: Albanian Student Protests
europe_now.summary: Demonstrations in Albania have escalated sharply, resulting in clashes with police and the looting of an EU campus facility. Protestors continue to demand the resignation of the prime minister amid the unrest.

sources.headline: College of Europe looted and torched during Albanian student protests
Student protests spread in Albania as demonstrators call for PM resignation

top_stories.title: Black Sea Maritime Security
top_stories.summary: A drone strike caused a severe fire on a tanker operating off the Romanian coastline, leaving several crew members missing. Defense allies are preparing to discuss the security implications of these maritime attacks.

sources.headline: NATO allies to meet over Black Sea drone attacks on shipping

top_stories.title: Unrest in Albania
top_stories.summary: Anti-government demonstrations in Albania have turned increasingly destructive as protesters clash with police forces. Educational infrastructure, including an EU campus building, suffered significant damage during the disturbances.

sources.headline: Police and protesters face off in Albania on third day of anti-govt demonstrations
